title: 260426_164343_FR_Old_steam_train_and_modern_electric_train by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Old steam train and modern electric train meeting. I made this recording during ‘’La fête de la vapeur’’ (The Steam Festival), held in La Baie de Somme (north of France), at the end of April 2026. Here, one can hear an old steam train whistling, while a modern electric train arrives and stops in Noyelles Station. At #1:37, the modern train closes its doors,then, when leaving (at #2:16), it activates its horn to great its ancestor ! ;-) In the background, someone talking in French, English and German in a loudspeaker, as well as the atmosphere of the station and some people’s voices.
